scope: Mishary Rashid Alafasy prayer recording identity, exact prayer match and republication basis. This audit does not edit the app catalog, recording manifest or version.

readyRecordings.permissionBasis: IslamHouse publisher FAQ section 2 states its published third-party works have open rights and visitors may republish through various media with source attribution and without changing the scientific content. Section 12 distinguishes commercial reuse of third-party productions; this assessment is for the stated free, nonmonetized app. This is a publisher republication statement for this IslamHouse edition, not a direct personal license from the reader and not permission for unrelated Alfan or YouTube editions.
readyRecordings.attribution: Mişârî Râşid el-Afâsî — IslamHouse.com, Sabah zikirleri 1419. Kaynak ve yeniden yayım koşulları: https://islamhouse.com/ar/audios/92368/ ; https://d1.islamhouse.com/html/faq.htm
readerIdentityEvidence: Publisher page title and author explicitly name مشاري بن راشد العفاسي.
Source MP3 artist and album_artist tags name القارئ: مشاري بن راشد العفاسي; publisher tag is www.islamhouse.com.
Saved primary page: test-results/mishary-prayers-mishary.html. A later web-tool revisit returned HTTP 429; the previously retrieved HTML and working exact audio are retained.

matching.prayer: One complete Seyyidul istighfar recitation, from Allahumma anta rabbi through illa anta; no surrounding hadith explanation or neighboring prayer is included.
matching.secondLaka: The approximate ASR repeatedly recognizes wa abuu bi dhanbi without a second laka, consistent with the current app Arabic and Turkish transliteration. Do not add a second laka solely on this recording's account.
matching.validationLimit: Source attribution, rough independent Arabic ASR identity, source context and acoustic separators agree. Whisper-tiny is not an authoritative literal transcript or word alignment. No word-level or clause-level practice timings are supplied.

cutEvidence.silenceDetection: ffmpeg silencedetect noise=-22dB:d=0.08, applied to this exact recording only
cutEvidence.nextSpeechExcluded: The following man qalaha muqinan... hadith explanation starts after the 459.128526–459.409887 separator; the excerpt ends inside that separator.

conversion.command: ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -ss 423.32 -t 35.96 -i test-results/mishary-1419-sabah.mp3 -vn -map_metadata -1 -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 128k [accurate source attribution metadata] assets/dua-audio/mishary-istigfar.mp3
conversion.changes: A complete prayer excerpt was isolated at the actual separators, MP3 re-encoded at 128 kbps, original 44.1 kHz stereo retained, irrelevant blog tags omitted and accurate source attribution added. No time stretch, pitch adjustment, word reordering or alteration to spoken content.

No verified Mishary performance of the exact long traditional Quran-opening prayer was located. Keep text available and do not substitute a different supplication or synthesized reader imitation.
